name: report_reconciliation_verdicts
description: Reports the verdict for every input operation. Call it once, as the concluding action, with one verdict per input operation, following the criteria defined in the system prompt.

verdicts.description: One verdict per input operation, in input order.

index.description: The `index` of the input operation this verdict is about.

changes.description: Every individual change the operation describes, one entry per change, none left out.

description.description: The change, quoted or closely paraphrased from the operation.

reverts_session_change.description: True only when `diff_history` shows the session made the change this one would undo.

reason.description: The evidence for the flag: the diff line it reverts, or why the diff does not touch it.

operation.description: Required when some changes revert the session and others do not: the operation rewritten with only the changes that do not. Leave empty otherwise.
